reviewScope: Independent copyright and provenance review; no app or deployment changes

decisionMeaning.eligible-with-conditions: Rights basis adequate for the identified version only; generated files, integrity and notices require final validation
decisionMeaning.hold: Insufficient rights or provenance evidence; not a finding of infringement

layerPolicy.originalWork: Record original author, publication, Korean and US term basis separately
layerPolicy.transcription: Respect Wikisource contributors rights, attribution, CC BY-SA 4.0 and actual changes where applicable
layerPolicy.modernTranslation: No third-party modern translation or creative editorial layer justified solely by a Wikisource page footer
layerPolicy.publicDomain: Do not impose new exclusive restrictions on the public-domain original
layerPolicy.officialGonguFiles: Use directly supplied file and its item-level expired classification; do not mix with unverified Wikisource modernization

redistributionRequirements.licenseMinimum: Creator and designated attribution, supplied copyright/disclaimer notices, source URI, license URL, actual changes; share-alike for covered adaptations; no additional restrictions on granted freedoms
redistributionRequirements.txt: Keep rights and source notice in standalone download or inseparable accompanying package
redistributionRequirements.json: Keep rights, attribution/source URLs and modification notice with body or directly linked rights record
redistributionRequirements.scanTransclusion: Parent page revision alone does not pin the transcluded Page text; retain child revisions and histories
redistributionRequirements.codeAndContent: Distinguish independent app code license, PD original and CC transcription layer

unverifiedBoundary: No claim of full textual collation, final generated-package attribution validation, deployment validation or independent legal clearance for unspecified later editions

reviewSummary.finalPackageValidation: Parent must validate generated app files and deployed notices
